description: Get daily click/impression/CTR/position trend for a specific search query. Use this to track how a particular keyword's ranking and traffic evolves over time. Requires Google Search Console to be connected. Direct the user to rankparse.com/dashboard/integrations to connect it. When several Google accounts are connected, the property is read through the account that can see it.

query.description: Search query to track e.g. "best seo tools"

name: get_gsc_query_trend
